text:
sarah.k: Quick heads-up — planning a tf apply for tenant VPC cutover in ~40m. Changes: subnet split, NAT consolidation, and svc-bus IAM binding. Plan is in PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/tenant-vpc/1234

sarah.k: staged canary: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~30m. Ack if you need the window moved.

devin: ack. Ill monitor routing tests and service e2e. Do we have a clear rollback path?

mike_infra: rollback = `terraform apply` previous tag (v2026-03-01-rollback). That reattaches old routes and removes new NAT. Manual peering re-register step noted.

elaine: tagging @oncall-amber since IAM bindings cross accounts. Amber, prefer abort on any 403 spike?

oncall-amber: here. Abort if >3% 403s or any unexpected control-plane 5xx. Also watch `sts:AssumeRole` latency.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued apply: infra/tenant-vpc PR #1234 — scheduled for 40m. Canary policy set. Auto-rollback thresholds: 403_rate>3% | route-failure>2%.

devin: example smoke check once canary flips: `for ip in $(cat canary_ips); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://$ip/health || echo failure:$ip; done`

mike_infra: preflight `terraform plan` snippet:
```
# aws_route.gateway will be changed in-place
+ aws_nat_gateway.canary (new)
- aws_nat_gateway.old_nat (tainted)
+ aws_iam_role_binding.tenant_svc: will add 1 binding
```
No peering drift.

elaine: are we rotating KMS keys?

mike_infra: not in this change. Key policy unchanged.

sarah.k: timeline: apply T+40, canary T+55, monitor 20m then ramp. Post-apply publish release notes and tag repo.

devin: if canary fails, runbook?

mike_infra: short runbook:
1) `deploy-bot abort` -> stops rollout and triggers rollback job.
2) `terraform apply -var-file=rollback-vars.tfvars -target=module.tenant_vpc` with tag v2026-03-01-rollback.
3) If peering flaps: `ssh net-admin@jump` -> `sudo bgpctl reset neighbor x.x.x.x`
4) Open incident and notify product owners.

elaine: Ill be on IAM approvals and watch CloudWatch for `AssumeRole` errors.

oncall-amber: add temp alarm for window: if `AssumeRoleErrors > 1` in 5m, page me.

mike_infra: created CloudWatch alarm `Tenant/AssumeRoleErrors-ephemeral` threshold 1 (5m) -> pager.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] starting canary apply now (operator: mike_infra). Logs: https://deploylogs/tenant-vpc/1769997777/canary

sarah.k: watching. will post progress here.

devin: canary smoke: all 200s, avg latency 72ms, no 403s.

mike_infra: canary succeeded. Rolling to 30%.

devin: 30% okay. one transient 502 at T+22 recovered.

elaine: IAM audit shows expected `AssumeRole` entries, no denies.

oncall-amber: alarm fired once from test account; cleared, not paging.

mike_infra: moving to 60% in 10m. Full apply at T+50 if no issues.

sarah.k: reminder: update release notes after full ramp with PR link, rollback tag, and contact matrix.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] full rollout complete. Tagging repo: tenant-vpc@v2026-03-15-cutover

devin: post-roll smoke all green. Ill run 1h routing consistency checks.

elaine: publishing release note draft: "Tenant VPC cutover: subnet split, NAT consolidation, svc-bus role bind. Rollback tag: v2026-03-01-rollback. Oncall: Amber. Infra owner: mike_infra."

sarah.k: leaving thread open until T+80. If anything odd, call rollback.

mike_infra: PR merged and archived. Will follow up with postmortem if drift observed in 24h.

oncall-amber: ACK.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] automated rollback job on standby until T+80.

sarah.k: closing window at T+80 — all quiet. Great job team. :tada:
